notes.title: Thief Simulator 2 - Pre-release Notes
notes.notes:
🚨🔥Just ONE DAY left! Are you ready to sneak, steal, and strategize? The ultimate heist is almost here! 🔥🚨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40415236/4603da53915a6bb2564dc40af1602574f2813dad.jpg

Attention all aspiring thieves! We're just around the corner from the grand launch of Thief Simulator 2. Here's everything you need to know:

📅 Release Date: October 4, 2023

⏰ Release Time:
 CEST: 15:00
 EDT (USA East Coast): 09:00
 PDT (USA West Coast): 06:00
 CST (China): 21:00
 IST (India): 18:30
💸 Price: 19.99 EUR/USD

🎉 Launch Discount: Get 10% off for the first 7 days after release!

Key Features

🏘️ Maps: Dive into two large neighborhood maps featuring over 20 houses of varied sizes, each with a unique resident and unique behavior. Plus, tackle three medium-sized heist maps - a resort with 6 homes and a stealable golf cart, a warehouse with guards and a forklift, and a bank filled with gold.

📜 Missions: Engage in over 30 varied tasks. Whether it's planting a package, destroying evidence, or pulling off the perfect theft, there's always work for a skilled thief. Hunt for one-time contracts on unique items, car theft missions, car dismantling tasks, and over 30 Blackbay lists comprising diverse items that will fetch a pretty penny.

💪 Special Skills: Enhance your thief's capabilities with special skills (check out those fancy pink or blue icons on the right!).

🏡 Home Upgrades: A thief's home is their castle. Upgrade yours to facilitate your nefarious activities.

🚁 Drones & Upgrades: Scout and plan better with different drones, each offering unique capabilities. Don't forget to upgrade them for even more sneaky power!

🤫 Mystery on Madison St.: There's something very unusual in Madison St. and only 0.1% of players have the chance to encounter it. Will you be one of them?

🎥 New Trailer: Ready to get even more hyped? Check out our new trailer here.

[previewyoutube=lSieK1HHt68;full][/previewyoutube]

Special Offers

🕹️ For the Veterans. Special discount for owners of:
 Thief Simulator 1
 American Theft 80s
🎮 Friends & Family Discounts. For those who have other games from PlayWay, you're in for a treat. Eligible games:
 Car Mechanic Simulator 2021
 Prison Simulator
 Into the Flames
 Bum Simulator
 Farmers life
 Barnfinders
 Mr. Prepper
 Accident
 Police Shootout
 Gunsmith
 Contraband Police
 House Flipper

Get ready to embrace the world of thievery all over again! 🎩🔦🔐

Stay sneaky and see you in-game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332720/Thief_Simulator_2/

Regards,
Rafal, Ultimate Games Team

notes.title: The Heist Continues: 'Thief Simulator 2' Release Date Revealed!
notes.notes:
Prepare yourself, the underworld is about to expand! Coming this October 4th, 2023, Thief Simulator 2"will unlock a treasure trove of criminal endeavors, inviting you to forge your path in the grand landscape of theft and strategy.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43544778/b1f0507d7887fb959f5c81dc4c7baccafa008252.png

Explore and invade 2 diverse neighborhoods and 3 unique heist locations! Each with rich loots, from quiet suburban houses to gold-filled bank vaults, all ripe for the taking. Equip yourself with an array of tools, from crowbars to hacking laptops, and level up to master even more daring heists with enhanced skills and techniques.

Whether you're silently disabling security systems or hot-wiring high-speed sports cars for a quick getaway, the choices are all yours. The clock is ticking, the stakes are higher, and the police are just a step behind.

Gear up for "Thief Simulator 2," and embrace the thrill of being a mastermind criminal. October 4th marks the beginning of your reign in the criminal underworld. The countdown to "gone time" has officially begun!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332720/Thief_Simulator_2

Enjoy.

notes.title: Update 1.2 - bug fixes and more
notes.notes:

 Added Backpack skill
 Lowered car damage costs
 Delayed police response time
 Fixed bug with guard from 100 not moving
 Blackbay items are displayed in the shop
 People no longer shrink, there is a text indication when someone leaves

notes.title: Game Update | 1.1a
notes.notes:
Version 1.1a Changelog:

 Fixed the issue of breaking a window in 102.
 Fixed car suspension damage when driving (ex. on sidewalks. inclines).
 Slightly improved the game's loading time for a smoother gameplay experience.
 Added support for ultrawide resolutions to enhance the game's visual quality.
 Slightly increased the render distance to give players a better view of their surroundings.
 Fixed an issue where cars would push heavy objects away.
